```jsx
    {/* RIGHT COLUMN */}
    <RightSidebar>
      <CollapsiblePanel
        icon="play"
        label="Action Plans"
        expanded={true}
      >
        <EmptyState text="No action plans running" />
      </CollapsiblePanel>

      <CollapsiblePanel
        icon="activity"
        label="Activity"
        expanded={true}
        rightLabel={<LastSeenIndicator text="Seen 6 days ago" />}
      />

      <CollapsiblePanel
        icon="tasks"
        label={<>Tasks <Badge count={19} /></>}
        expanded={true}
        actions={[
          <LightningButton title="Smart task" />,
          <PlusButton title="Add task" />
        ]}
      >
        <TaskList>
          <TaskItem
            type="call"
            title="Buyer intent page activity. Follow up now."
            dueAt="May 17th 2026 at 2:26 PM"
            assignedTo="Matt Ryan"
            overdue
          />
          <TaskItem
            type="call"
            title="Lead returned to website. Follow up now."
            dueAt="May 21st 2026 at 7:58 AM"
            assignedTo="Matt Ryan"
            overdue
          />
          {/* ...10 more "Lead returned to website" tasks... */}
        </TaskList>
      </CollapsiblePanel>
    </RightSidebar>

  </ThreeColumnLayout>

  <HelpFab /> {/* floating "?" button, bottom-right */}
</PersonDetailPage>
```

### Non-obvious Implementation Notes

1. **"Matt alert" events are auto-generated:** FUB's pixel tracking on ryan-realty.com sends website visit webhooks back to FUB. Each visit creates a timeline event of type "website_visit" with the visited URL, page title, and a follow-up task ("Lead returned to website. Follow up now."). The actor displayed is "Matt Ryan" because Matt is both the contact AND the tracked user — FUB is tracking his own website visits against his own contact record.

2. **Viewing yourself as a contact:** This is an unusual state — the logged-in broker (Matt Ryan) is viewing their own contact record. This is valid in FUB because the broker's email was captured as a lead. The system cannot distinguish between broker and public visitor at the pixel level.

3. **Seller Inquiry event:** The event type "Seller Inquiry" with source "ryanrealtyvercel.app" indicates a webhook from a multi-step seller form. The "partial lead" language means the person completed step 1 (address entry) but did not finish step 2 — the address "1234 NW Riverview Dr, Bend, OR 97703" was captured and the source tagged as "seller-lp". This is likely a form built on ryanrealtyvercel.app posting to FUB's /events API.

4. **Activity filter counts:** The tab showing "22" for person-events and "22" for a second category likely means 22 website visit events logged. The duplication across two tabs may reflect that website visits are classified under two categories simultaneously (e.g., both "person activity" and "system alert").

5. **Task overdue display:** All 19 tasks have past due dates (May–June 2026). In production FUB, overdue tasks typically display the due date in red. Here the dates appear in blue (link-styled), suggesting the date itself may be clickable to view/edit the task.

6. **"No communication yet":** This status under the contact name means no outbound email, SMS, or call has been sent FROM FUB to this contact. Website visit events do not count as "communication" for this indicator.

7. **Relationships vs. Deals:** The "Relationships" section links contacts to other contacts (e.g., spouse, co-buyer, referral source). It is separate from Deals, which would appear in the Deals nav section.

8. **Financing section:** Likely stores pre-approval status and lender contact for buyer leads. For this contact (which is effectively Matt's own record), it's naturally empty.

9. **Background section:** A free-text memo field about the contact — like a sticky note. Typically used to store context that doesn't fit structured fields.

10. **Social Profile > Google:** FUB provides a quick-search link rather than a true social profile integration. Clicking "Search Matthew Ryan" opens `https://www.google.com/search?q=Matthew+Ryan` in a new tab. More robust social integrations (LinkedIn lookup, etc.) may be available in other FUB tiers.

11. **Three-column layout breakpoints:** On narrower viewports, the right sidebar (Tasks/Action Plans) likely collapses or moves below the main content. The left sidebar may collapse into a slide-out panel. [INFERRED from common FUB behavior]

12. **"Seen 6 days ago":** This is the `last_seen_at` timestamp from website pixel tracking — the most recent website visit recorded. It lives in the right sidebar's Activity section header, not in the main timeline.

13. **Lightning bolt (⚡) on Tasks:** In FUB, the lightning bolt typically triggers "Smart Plans" or auto-creates suggested follow-up tasks based on the contact's stage or recent activity, distinct from manually clicking "+" to create an empty task.
